description: Create a SELLAT proof of existence for a local file. The file is hashed on this machine and only its SHA-256 (plus the name and size) is sent; the file itself never leaves the computer. Stamping the same file again returns the existing proof (the earlier date is the stronger one). Set qualified=true only when the user explicitly asked for the qualified eIDAS seal: it spends one seal from the account.

name.description: Name shown on the certificate. Defaults to the file name.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to protect (~ is expanded).

qualified.description: Also issue the qualified timestamp (eIDAS). Spends one seal. Only if the user asked for it.

name: sellat_stamp
title: Protect a file
